answer: Question: How can a trellis ward off falcon swarms without drowning in compute? Each agent’s voice is stamped by an atlas of latent tide maps; to lie, Sybils must rerender the exact tide soundprint. Cost: 12 ms of serial ocean-surface reverberation per fake head—parallel farms lack the unique basin bathymetry of the harbor’s subfloor, so every replica tide drowns the attacker in singular wave phasing.
